name: sketchflow-mcp
description: SketchFlow: a vector sketch board and a parametric 3D modeller (mates, features, STEP export, gears, welding) that AI assistants drive through MCP while you watch and edit in your browser.
author: 4Ship_ca

scripts.test: node model/test/kernel.test.mjs && node model/test/model.test.mjs && node model/test/gears.test.mjs && node model/test/welding.test.mjs && node model/test/addons.test.mjs && node model/test/collide.test.mjs && node model/test/reference.test.mjs && node model/test/step.test.mjs && node model/test/collab.test.mjs && node model/test/rooms.test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/release-prep.mjs --check && npm test && node scripts/smoke.mjs
